title: This pisses me off to no end…
hook: This pisses me off to no end…
caption:
This pisses me off to no end…

Why are we arguing about how people should be eating food that’s actually healthy for them?

It’s not super indifferent to when we were all arguing about whether oatmeal is healthy or unhealthy.

We have a population that is largely unhealthy because they’re eating too much takeout, not enough at home, and not enough fruits and veggies. 

Why are we trying to create boundaries around when we should eat them? Or how we should eat them?

Eat the fruit. 

If you want to mix blueberries and banana’s in a smoothie then do it! 

Man, I’m tired of this shit.
